title: Host — Kernel & System Logs
description: Live log streams kldload's promtail ships to Loki — ZED ZFS events, kldload tooling output, ZFS module debug, klab test runs. Plus journald (when promtail has read access — see footer note).

options.content:
### What's here

Log streams kldload's **promtail** ships to **Loki** in real time. Click any panel header → Explore for full LogQL drilldown.

### If the systemd-journal panel is blank

Promtail's `journal` scraper needs read access to `/run/log/journal/<machine-id>/`. On fresh kldload installs the promtail user may not be in the `systemd-journal` group. Fix: `sudo usermod -aG systemd-journal promtail && sudo systemctl restart promtail`. The ZED + kldload-apps + ZFS dbgmsg + klab streams work without that — they're file-tail scrapers, not journald.
